tools.name: list_pay_methods
tools.description:
Pay methods of the exchange: what the client can give (pay with) and receive.

        Each method has a `code` used by the other tools. `search` filters by
        name, currency, code or network (e.g. "USDT", "Monobank", "TRC20").

tools.name: list_receive_options
tools.description: What the client can receive for the method they give (by its `code`).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description:
A quote for an exchange and the link to make it on the site.

        `give` and `receive` are method codes; `amount` is what the client gives
        (amount_side="give") or wants to receive (amount_side="receive"). Returns
        both amounts, the rate, the limits, the requisites the site will as

tools.name: about_exchange
tools.description:
The exchange itself: the site, terms, support, and the independent
        monitors and review sites listing it (its rating and reviews are there).

tools.name: get_reserves
tools.description: How much of each currency the exchange can pay out now (by currency, then method).
